description: This file defines the Inspector2Client class in the Aws\Inspector2 namespace, which acts as a client for interacting with the AWS Inspector2 service. It includes method annotations for various service operations and inherits from the Aws\AwsClient base class.

classes.name: Inspector2Client
classes.description: A client for AWS Inspector2 service, enabling interaction with the service via the listed methods.

methods.name: associateMember
methods.description: Associates a member account with the Inspector2 service.

methods.description: Asynchronously associates a member account with the Inspector2 service.

methods.description: Retrieves the account status in batch.
